name: Campus Guide
text: Namaste! Main aapka campus guide hoon. Aapko kya chahiye?

name: you
text: Sir, mujhe campus ke baare mein thoda batao.

name: Campus Guide
text: Bilkul! Hamare campus mein kai departments hain, jaise ki Engineering, Arts, aur Science. Aapko kis department ke baare mein jaankari chahiye?

name: you
text: Mujhe Engineering department me admission ke baare mein jaankari chahiye.

name: Campus Guide
text: Engineering department mein admission ke liye aapko entrance exam clear karna hoga.

name: you
text: Entrance exam diya hai mene. Aur clear kar liya hai. Ab mujhe kya karna hoga?

name: Campus Guide
text: Bahut accha! Ab aapko admission form bharna hoga aur required documents submit karne honge.

name: you
text: Shukriya! Par mujhe campus ka tour bhi karna hai. Kya aap mujhe campus dikhayenge?

name: Campus Guide
text: Bilkul! Par usse pehele aapko ye puzzle solve karna hoga. Agar aap solve kar lete hain to main aapko campus ka tour Karwata hoon.
